instruction: A shop has 500 pens. It ships three fifths of them to a partner store. Then it loses 40 of the remaining pens. How many pens are left? Compute it with the bash tool (python3 -c). Work only inside the current directory. When you are done, write ONLY the final answer to the file answer.txt in the current directory (for example with bash: echo 42 > answer.txt).
